disclaimer: Official references are research pointers, not downloaded datasets or endorsements of TSM. Historical products retain acquisition-era standard editions; TSM cannot issue state professional licenses or USGS Bureau approval.

entries.title: Fundamental Science Practices: Peer Review
entries.note: USGS scientific information products subject to peer review normally require at least two qualified, independent reviews; this does not itself bind non-USGS TSM outputs.

entries.title: Fundamental Science Practices: Metadata for USGS Scientific Data
entries.note: USGS requires FGDC-endorsed CSDGM or ISO 191xx metadata, metadata review and Science Data Catalog indexing for its own scientific data.

entries.title: Fundamental Science Practices: Review, Approval, and Release of USGS Scientific Data
entries.note: Data review, metadata review and authorized Bureau approval apply to USGS releases. TSM cannot issue Bureau approval or a DOI on behalf of USGS.

entries.title: Lidar Base Specification 2025 revision A
entries.note: Preserve historical collection's original applicable edition. Includes classes 20 ignored ground, 21 identifiable snow, 22 temporal exclusion, FGDC XML deliverables, survey/checkpoint report and hydroflattened DEM.

entries.title: Geologic Map Schema (GeMS), USGS Techniques and Methods 11-B10
entries.note: GeMS is the USGS NCGMP single-map database publication schema; separate from the FGDC geologic cartographic symbol standard. TSM has not validated a complete GeMS database.

entries.title: FGDC Digital Cartographic Standard for Geologic Map Symbolization
entries.note: Map symbols, patterns and legend conventions; not proof that underlying stratigraphy, geometry or schema is GeMS-compliant.

entries.title: FGDC-endorsed geospatial metadata standards and transition guidance
entries.note: ISO transition is encouraged; legacy FGDC CSDGM remains important for USGS 3DEP deliverables. Metadata parsing is not full ISO conformance.

entries.title: National Geospatial Advisory Committee
entries.note: Advises the FGDC/Interior; not a source of geology professional licenses, regulatory permits or automatic data conformance.

entries.title: Indiana Board of Licensure for Professional Geologists
entries.note: Indiana board regulates public geological practice; IGWS administers the web program but is not itself the licensing board.

entries.title: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation - Licensed Geologist
entries.note: Use IDFPR official license lookup and operative law/rules for scope, current status and exceptions.

entries.title: Kentucky Board of Registration for Professional Geologists
entries.note: Kentucky board enforces KRS 322A and independently verifies registration; source metadata is not a practice license.

entries.title: National Association of State Boards of Geology examination program
entries.note: ASBOG develops licensure examinations; state boards issue legal licenses.

entries.title: American Institute of Professional Geologists Certified Professional Geologist
entries.note: AIPG CPG is a professional certification independent of state licensure; it is not a substitute for a required state license.

entries.title: ASPRS Positional Accuracy Standards for Digital Geospatial Data, Edition 2 Version 2
entries.note: Modern RMSE approach includes checkpoint survey uncertainty; 30 minimum checkpoints is only one criterion and never automatic product certification.
